entries.purpose.title: Murakaza neza kuri Rinda
entries.purpose.body: Rinda igufasha kumenya imyitwarire ya buri munsi igira ingaruka ku buzima bwawe. Ni iy'inyigisho, si isuzuma rya muganga, kandi si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse. Ushobora gusimbuka ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose.
entries.neutral.title: Ushobora gufunga iyi paji.
entries.email.report.subject: Incamake y'isuzuma ryawe kuri Rinda
entries.email.report.greeting: Muraho. Dore incamake y'isuzuma ryawe riheruka kuri Rinda. Buri gice kirebwa ukwacyo.
entries.email.report.disclaimer: Iyi ncamake ni iyo kwiga, si isuzuma rya muganga, kandi Rinda si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse. Niba wumva utameze neza cyangwa uhangayitse, vugana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
entries.email.report.optout: Wakiriye iyi imeri kubera ko wafunguye raporo kuri imeri mu Mwirondoro wawe kuri Rinda. Ushobora kuzifunga aho igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
entries.rules.intro: Buri gisubizo gikomoka ku mategeko adahinduka yavuye mu mabwiriza y'ubuzima yatangajwe. Ibisubizo bimwe bihora bitanga igisubizo kimwe. Aya mategeko ni verisiyo {version}.
entries.rules.skipped: Ikibazo wasimbutse ntikibarwa nka 0. Iyo igice kidafite ibisubizo bihagije, kigaragaza "Nta makuru ahagije".
entries.rules.tobacco: Niba ubu ukoresha itabi iryo ari ryo ryose, iki gisubizo gisaba kwitonderwa.
entries.rules.alcohol: Duteranya ibisubizo byawe bitatu ku kunywa inzoga (0 kugeza 12). Igiteranyo cya {male} cyangwa birenga ku bagabo, cyangwa {female} cyangwa birenga ku bagore, gisaba kwitonderwa.
entries.rules.activity: Duteranya iminota yawe y'imyitozo iciriritse n'inshuro {multiplier} iminota y'imyitozo ikomeye buri cyumweru. Iminota {meetsAt} cyangwa irenga yujuje inama.
entries.rules.diet: Ibipimo {meetsAt} cyangwa birenga by'imbuto n'imboga ku munsi byujuje inama.
entries.rules.bmi: Igipimo cy'umubiri (BMI) ni ibiro byawe ugabanyije uburebure bwawe muri metero bwikubye. Munsi ya {normal} ni ibiro bike, {normal} kugeza kuri {overweight} ni urugero rwiza, {overweight} kugeza kuri {obesity} ni ibiro byinshi, naho {obesity} cyangwa birenga ni umubyibuho ukabije.
entries.rules.waist: Ku bagabo, umukenyero wa cm {m1} cyangwa irenga uriyongereye, naho cm {m2} cyangwa irenga wiyongereye cyane. Ku bagore, izo ntambwe ni cm {f1} na cm {f2}.
entries.rules.bp: Igipimo kinini mu bipimo byawe bibiri ni cyo gifata icyemezo. {hnS}/{hnD} cyangwa birenga ni hejuru gato y'ibisanzwe, {htS}/{htD} cyangwa birenga ni mu rwego rw'umuvuduko ukabije, naho {uS}/{uD} cyangwa birenga bisaba kwivuza uyu munsi.
entries.rules.phq9: Duteranya ibisubizo byawe icyenda (0 kugeza 27). {mild} cyangwa birenga ni bike, {moderate} cyangwa birenga ni biringaniye, {ms} cyangwa birenga ni byinshi, naho {severe} cyangwa birenga ni byinshi cyane.
entries.rules.gad7: Duteranya ibisubizo byawe birindwi (0 kugeza 21). {mild} cyangwa birenga ni bike, {moderate} cyangwa birenga ni biringaniye, naho {severe} cyangwa birenga ni byinshi cyane.
entries.rules.support: Niba igiteranyo icyo ari cyo cyose kigeze kuri {tier1} cyangwa kirenga, Rinda yerekana ubutumwa bwo kugushyigikira n'aho wabona ubufasha. Ibisubizo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro ntibijya biteranywa n'ibindi bisubizo.
